rows.claim: Snapshot and log inspection walk instances (§13.3)
rows.evidence: spec.md:11411-11413 (§13.3 table) says inspection reads the address table, a cell the structure has. Code holds strings: Layout.addr and component_paths (src/build.jl:357-365); probe:372 reads by path string. The sentence also contradicts the next one, that a path is unrecoverable from an instance.
rows.fix: Snapshot and log inspection read the address table by path ([§13.3][s13-3]).

rows.claim: Two entries producing the same output face remain the ordinary two-producers error (§6.1)
rows.evidence: probe:139 (output_wires "b/y"=>"out", "a/y"=>"out") gives only FaceNameCollision site=:assembly, no TwoProducers; src/structure.jl:756-770 fires on the repeated face name. TwoProducers arises only for an input fed twice (probe:149).
rows.fix: Two entries naming the same output face are `FaceNameCollision`, since face names are unique across the two boundary declarations. An input fed twice remains the ordinary two-producers error ([§6.1][s6-1]).

rows.claim: A face name contains no `/` is a build-checked invariant of every face name
rows.evidence: src/structure.jl:756-762 checks it only on assembly boundary faces; check_contract_names (src/assembly.jl:700-706) checks only emptiness of contract keys. probe:421: a primitive with u_types key Symbol("a/b") builds with no diagnostic. declare.jl:183 and 221 also promise only the empty-name refusal.
rows.fix: Make check_contract_names refuse a contract key holding `/` as FaceNameIllegal with invariant :contains_slash; or, if primitive ports are exempt, say the slash invariant covers assembly boundary faces.

rows.claim: In code, the sculling result is the sampler line `υ_c_sc = s.q'(u.V - s.V)`
rows.evidence: The code block at spec.md:4226-4229 writes `q_s = RQuat(s.q, normalization = false)` and `υ_c_sc = q_s'(u.V - s.V)`. `s.q` is a bare SVector{4}, so `s.q'` is no rotation (§7.1's explicit cast, spec.md:4213). probe:292 runs the block form.
rows.fix: In code, the sculling result is the sampler line `υ_c_sc = q_s'(u.V - s.V)`, with `q_s = RQuat(s.q, normalization = false)`.
